elements.description: An onboarding panel: a progress bar and collapsible groups of tasks that unlock one after another.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the region's name

properties.name: groups
properties.description: The task groups. Each task's `done` flag is where it starts; when the flags change, the guide follows them

properties.name: done
properties.description: Ids of the finished tasks; unset follows the tasks' flags. Changed by a tick unless tc-done-change is prevented

properties.name: openGroup
properties.description: Id of the unfolded group, null for none; unset unfolds the first unfinished group

properties.name: minimized
properties.description: The body is collapsed to the header

properties.name: editable
properties.description: Shows an "Edit" link in the header (fires tc-edit)

properties.name: closable
properties.description: Shows a close button in the header (fires tc-close)

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-done-change
events.description: A task was ticked or cleared (detail: { done: string[] }, the ids of all finished tasks); cancelable

events.name: tc-open-group-change
events.description: A group unfolded or folded, also when a finished group folds away on its own (detail: { openGroup: string | null }); cancelable

events.name: tc-minimized-change
events.description: The body was collapsed or expanded (detail: { minimized: boolean }); cancelable

events.name: tc-edit
events.description: The Edit link was pressed (shown with `editable`); detail: null

events.name: tc-close
events.description: The close button was pressed (shown with `closable`); detail: null

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the region's name

props.name: groups
props.description: The task groups. Each task's `done` flag is where it starts; when the flags change, the guide follows them

props.name: done
props.description: Ids of the finished tasks. Controlled when defined – pair it with `onDoneChange`

props.name: defaultDone
props.description: Ids finished on mount when `done` isn't controlled – defaults to the tasks marked `done`

props.name: onDoneChange
props.description: Called with the ids of all finished tasks whenever a task is ticked or cleared

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the ids of all finished tasks, like `onDoneChange`

props.name: openGroup
props.description: Id of the unfolded group, `null` for none. Controlled when defined – pair it with `onOpenGroupChange`

props.name: defaultOpenGroup
props.description: Group unfolded on mount when `openGroup` isn't controlled – defaults to the first unfinished group

props.name: onOpenGroupChange
props.description: Called when a group unfolds or folds – also when a finished group folds away on its own

props.name: minimized
props.description: Whether the body is collapsed to the header. Controlled when defined – pair it with `onMinimizedChange`

props.name: defaultMinimized
props.description: Whether the body starts collapsed when `minimized` isn't controlled

props.name: onMinimizedChange
props.description: Called when the body is collapsed or expanded

props.name: onEdit
props.description: Shows an "Edit" link in the header

props.name: onClose
props.description: Shows a close button in the header

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
